intro: Stolen Blasting Powder is a quest at Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh where adventurers must recover missing munitions. Primitive troggs have made off with enough explosive powder to level a fortress wing, forcing Quarrymaster Thesten to recruit discreet help before a catastrophe occurs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This keg held enough powder to turn King Magni's throne room into an open air courtyard. We've got to get it back from the troggs before they work out how to ignite it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I hope you've got good news for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: That should be all the stolen powder. Thank you, adventurer.
Please accept this reward, and... I'd appreciate if you didn't mention this little incident to anyone.
